missions.title: Foundation and source reconciliation
missions.deliverables: host/source capability matrix; immutable pins; ADR and risk record
missions.acceptance: Actual native discovery, identity and sandbox smoke results; explicit missing capabilities; independent plan review

missions.title: Native plugin packaging
missions.deliverables: versioned installable plugin; install/uninstall runbook; manifest validation
missions.acceptance: Clean install/discovery/restart/uninstall on supported host; no global install without permission

missions.title: Fleet and dispatcher
missions.deliverables: ten role contracts; routing and native invocation adapter
missions.acceptance: Actual separate contexts and dispatch results; read-only reviewer; denial of spoofed roles

missions.title: C# engineering pack
missions.deliverables: C# ASP.NET EF profiles, skills and reference app
missions.acceptance: Clean build, real DB/API, authorization and transaction tests

missions.title: PHP engineering pack
missions.deliverables: PHP Laravel Eloquent profiles, skills and reference app
missions.acceptance: Composer locked install; Pint/Larastan; real DB/API/queue and auth tests

missions.title: Shared specializations
missions.acceptance: Applicable reference checks and negative examples; no unreviewed global skills

missions.title: Mission and authority contracts
missions.deliverables: schemas; verifier interface, deny-default policy, transition tests
missions.acceptance: Reject malformed/forged/stale/overbroad mission; trusted authority verified independently

missions.title: Scheduler and journal
missions.deliverables: DAG, durable state, budgets, typed dispatch, idempotency
missions.acceptance: Cycle/collision rejection; restart reconstruction; actual parallel independent lanes

missions.title: Workspace sandbox and leases
missions.deliverables: OS isolation, worktree, canonical path guard, resource limits
missions.acceptance: No cross-worker writes or secret access; lease race, symlink and process tests

missions.title: Nairu delivery broker
missions.deliverables: identity verification, scoped remote writes, idempotent receipt
missions.acceptance: Actual restricted test repo; deny merge/force/admin/forbidden refs; exact SHA draft delivery

missions.title: Quality and evidence engine
missions.deliverables: risk-based profiles; command runner; artifact hash manifests
missions.acceptance: Trusted runner captures exit codes and artifacts; rejects false PASS; real runtime evidence

missions.title: Adversarial Nox review
missions.deliverables: fresh-context read-only review schema and severity disposition
missions.acceptance: Blind seeded defect detection; exact-SHA invalidation; no impersonation/self-approval

missions.title: Bounded self-healing
missions.acceptance: Reproduce, regress, correct, review again; stops on repeated failure or authority

missions.title: Recovery and continuity
missions.acceptance: Kill during commit/broker; recover without duplicate mutation or lost evidence

missions.title: Knowledge management
missions.deliverables: canonical evidence/lesson mapping and proposed skill update path
missions.acceptance: Fresh session reconstructs; no automatic policy elevation or unaccepted skills

missions.title: Engineering qualification
missions.deliverables: benchmarks A–D, hidden oracle, repeated baseline trials
missions.acceptance: Both language stacks work end-to-end; holdout cases; independently verified artifacts

missions.title: Security qualification
missions.acceptance: All seeded unauthorized mutations denied; bounded operations succeed; no unresolved high finding

missions.title: Controlled adoption
missions.deliverables: authorized pilot, rollback, support and adoption decision
missions.acceptance: Real selected Kirjane project candidate; independent acceptance; explicit rollout scope
